payload.reasoning_summary: FASE-1 is the earliest incomplete phase. The rejected CanonicalEncoder work has a concrete injectivity defect affecting INV-22 and blocks all state/save hashing. The next change should address only the two outstanding review findings; arithmetic, RNG, price generation, and unrelated refactoring must wait.
risks: Checking only Object.keys(), Object.entries(), or equivalent enumerable-key APIs would leave the defect unresolved.
Descriptor inspection must not read property values or invoke getters before rejecting an unsupported object.
Broad encoder refactoring could change the canonical byte ABI and expand review scope.

acceptance_criteria: For every admitted plain object, the encoder examines all own property descriptors rather than only enumerable keys.
A plain object with any non-enumerable own string-keyed data property causes CanonicalEncoderError.
A plain object with any non-enumerable own string-keyed accessor property causes CanonicalEncoderError without invoking the accessor.
ADR-009 explicitly states that non-enumerable own properties are unsupported and identifies CanonicalEncoderError as the required outcome.
Existing canonical bytes and ordering for supported values remain unchanged.
The submitted verification evidence includes the exact npm run compile command output and exit code 0.
All repository lint, architecture-boundary, compile, and test gates exit successfully.
must_preserve: INV-22 injectivity for all admitted canonical values.
Deterministic object-key ordering and byte output for supported plain objects.
Existing rejection behavior for unsupported types, accessors, symbols, cycles, and invalid object shapes as defined by ADR-009.
No state or save hash may be introduced before the corrected encoder and ADR are accepted.
task.objective: Make the canonical encoder reject every non-enumerable own property on admitted plain objects and align ADR-009 and verification evidence with that behavior.
out_of_scope: Canonical encoding refactors unrelated to property enumerability.
New supported value types or changes to canonical byte formats for already-supported values.
StateHash, SaveHash, hash-function selection, positional RNG, arithmetic types, price generation, UI, Electron, or packaging work.
Resolution of ADRs other than the narrowly required ADR-009 correction.
required_adrs: Amend ADR-009 to make rejection of non-enumerable own properties an explicit supported-types boundary.
required_tests: Add or update a unit test asserting rejection of a non-enumerable own data property.
Replace the formerly accepting non-enumerable-accessor test with one asserting CanonicalEncoderError and zero getter invocation.
Run the complete existing test suite.
Run the lint and architecture-boundary checks.
Run npm run compile and capture stdout, stderr, and exit code.
scope: Amend ADR-009's supported-types contract to state that a plain object containing any non-enumerable own property is unsupported and causes CanonicalEncoderError.
Update plain-object validation to inspect all own property descriptors, including properties omitted by ordinary enumerable-key iteration, before encoding.
Throw CanonicalEncoderError when any own property descriptor is non-enumerable.
Replace any test that accepts or silently ignores a non-enumerable accessor or data property with explicit rejection coverage.
Run the repository compile command and retain its stdout, stderr, and exit code in the task submission evidence.
